ITEM.PTXT: In the G menu, menus that match the user's purpose or interests can be searched for and executed from an extensive range of menus divided into categories.

ENTRY.PTXT: The emergency call system "HELPNET" service can be used.
Road conditions can be predicted and the optimum route avoiding congestion can be searched.
Music data of various genres can be easily enjoyed in the vehicle.
Trend spots such as town information, travel information and gourmet information can be searched.
Currently needed information such as sports, economy, news and weather can be searched.
Information for enjoying every day, such as games and music hit rankings, can be searched.
Communication contents such as e-mail and location information exchange can be used.
Contents such as confirming the current position of the vehicle can be used.

HINT.PTXT: Menu configuration and contents may be changed without notice to improve operability.
